annotations.title: robots.txt check for a user agent and URL

description: robots.txt check for a user agent and URL. Use when a task needs to know whether a given crawler or agent may fetch a given URL under the site's robots.txt, and which rule decided it. Parsed by RFC 9309 with longest-match precedence. Robots rules are a request from the site, not access control. Cost: 1 credit per call.

url.description: The public http(s) URL the agent wants to fetch.

user_agent.description: The robots.txt product token, such as GPTBot or ClaudeBot: letters, hyphen and underscore only, not a full browser string.

name: robots_check
